authority: Rio de Janeiro — CCR Barcas (Guanabara Bay ferry concession, under SETRANS-RJ)
jurisdiction: State of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
decarbonization_anchor: CCR Barcas runs the public ferry concession across Guanabara Bay — the water link that spares the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the bay's chronic road congestion. Rio de Janeiro State targets carbon neutrality by 2050 and Brazil holds a net-zero-by-2050 commitment; a zero-emission foiling layer decarbonises the bay's busiest public crossings while cutting the diesel and wake on a heavily-used estuary.
operator_facts: CCR Barcas holds the Guanabara Bay ferry concession; ~4 lines / ~9 stations from the Praça XV hub in central Rio to Niéteroi (Arariboia), Paquetá island, Cocotá (Ilha do Governador) and Charitas (fast catamaran). Praça XV–Niéteroi is one of the highest-frequency water crossings in Brazil.
